verdicts.decision_note: The client unambiguously accepts a separate D2D/Ingram cover artifact with its own 428-page configuration rather than reusing the Amazon cover.
The client postpones construction of the D2D cover pending confirmation of the system-relevant spine-width specification.
The source explicitly leaves the D2D cover's implementable spine width unresolved between 0.82 and 0.905 inches.
The client establishes the concrete D2D cover configuration: use the attached D2D template and its 0.82-inch spine width; no prior stored attribute becomes obsolete.
The instruction to proceed reactivates production of the D2D cover after resolving its spine-width specification.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that D2D-uploadable cover files were supplied, including an equivalent lower-file-size version; it does not claim runtime verification.
